message:
deploy checks failed in the 'production' environment:
  loom.cursors.E001: stores.settings.cursors.signing is 'ephemeral': cursor tokens are not signed with a key every instance shares. Hint: drop stores.settings.cursors.signing from the deployed configuration (signed is the default) and set stores.settings.cursors.current_key_id and stores.settings.cursors.keys, each key read from a mounted file (path) or an injected secret variable (env).
Deploy checks run in production and staging; LOOM_ENV unset means production. For local work set LOOM_ENV=development. To accept a finding on purpose, list its id under checks.silenced.
